defects: 𝕜 is weakened from NontriviallyNormedField + CompleteSpace (gold) to a bare DivisionRing (produced), dropping all norm/topology/completeness structure on the scalar field

Domain type (M vs gold's E) is only assumed AddCommMonoid instead of AddCommGroup, weakening the algebraic structure (and putting the well-definedness of the quotient M ⧸ p, which normally needs an additive group, in question)
Codomain type (N vs gold's F) is only assumed AddCommMonoid instead of AddCommGroup, same issue as above

Codomain N lacks IsTopologicalAddGroup/ContinuousAdd and ContinuousSMul assumptions that gold requires on F, so N is not actually shown to be a topological vector space — only a bare TopologicalSpace with no compatibility to the algebraic structure
Produced adds an unnecessary TopologicalSpace M hypothesis on the domain that is not present in gold (gold's shadowed E has no topology at all)

The finite-codimension/closed-image hypothesis is restructured from a universally quantified implicit submodule (with CoFG instance and closedness hypothesis) into an existential conjunction; while logically equivalent in isolation, combined with the weakened typeclasses above the overall statement is no longer equivalent to gold
